provenance: qwen 0.22.0 ACP `session/load` request/response shapes (the h14 resume-probe exchange). The request shape is the SDK's zLoadSessionRequest {cwd, mcpServers, sessionId}; the response shape is the bundle's loadSession response builder: {modes, models, configOptions} (+ artifactSnapshot when the persisted session carries one) - notably NO sessionId in the response, because the client names the session it loads. agentCapabilities.loadSession was measured true in the 2026-08-23 initialize response (spec c17). Whether a real qwen session SURVIVES its process restart and loads in a fresh process is what the named h14 probe (scripts/session_load_probe.py) measures per backend - the recorded result lives beside the probe script; the first-cut dispatch path does NOT consume this (continuation_ref is not implemented in the first cut, frame park v2).
